newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's share index drops 8.99 points.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's share index drops 8.99 points.

text.p: Bahrain's share index dropped by 8.99 points this week, depressed by a decline in banking and financial shares, official figures issued on Thursday showed.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) said the index fell to 1,538.92 points in the week ending on Thursday from 1,547.91 points the previous week.
Trading volume dropped to 6.4 million shares worth three million dinars ($7.96 million) from 9.4 million shares worth 3.1 million dinars a week earlier.
Shares of 17 firms out of 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 155 transactions, the bourse said.
BSE figure showed the bank share index fell 9.88 points, financial institutions 17.78 points and the services sector 4.34 points while the insurance sector index climbed 20.03 points.
The bourse said Investcorp shares continued to lead the market for the fourth consecutive week with more than three million shares worth 2.2 million dinars changing hands.
Investcorp's share price dropped $0.01 to close at $1.90 per share.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
